title: Layer Cake Export Schema
description: JSON Schema for Layer Cake methodology export format. Used by Ralph for importing/exporting Layer Cake configurations.
$comment: Functions (getLayer, getActor, getHierarchyLevel, getMinSubtasks) are replaced with '[Function: name]' strings in exports since JSON cannot represent JavaScript functions.

_export.description: Export metadata added during export process

schemaVersion.description: Version of the export schema (semver format)

exportTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the export was created

sourceFile.description: Optional: path to source file that generated this export

meta.description: Metadata about the Layer Cake methodology

version.description: Version of the Layer Cake methodology (e.g., '3.0')

description.description: Brief description of what Layer Cake does

actors.description: Map of actor IDs to actor definitions. Actors are the entities that perform work in the methodology.

hierarchy.description: Definition of the nested planning hierarchy (epic -> feature -> task -> subtask)

layers.description: Array of all 12 layers in the methodology, in order L1-L12

gates.description: Gate definitions - checkpoints that require approval or review

humanApproval.description: Layer IDs that require human approval (e.g., ['L3', 'L7'])

ganPlanReview.description: Layer IDs where GAN reviews planning artifacts

ganBuildReview.description: Layer IDs where GAN reviews build artifacts

failCascade.description: Rules for handling failures at different severity levels

minor.description: Rule for minor failures (typically: retry at same layer)

major.description: Rule for major failures (typically: go back one hierarchy level)

escalate.description: Rule for escalations (typically: go back two+ hierarchy levels)

maxRetries.description: Maximum retries before escalating to next severity level

getLayer.description: Placeholder for getLayer function (excluded in export)

getActor.description: Placeholder for getActor function (excluded in export)

getHierarchyLevel.description: Placeholder for getHierarchyLevel function (excluded in export)

getMinSubtasks.description: Placeholder for getMinSubtasks function (excluded in export)

Actor.description: An actor that performs work in the methodology

role.description: Description of what this actor does

HierarchyLevel.description: A level in the planning hierarchy

min.description: Minimum count required at this level

layer.description: Which layer creates items at this level

parent.description: Parent level type (null for top level)

timeScale.description: Expected time scale for items at this level

LayerCheck.description: Completion check criteria for a layer

FailRouting.description: Complex fail routing with severity-based targets

Layer.description: A layer in the Layer Cake methodology

phase.description: Which phase this layer belongs to

actor.description: Actor ID responsible for this layer

reviewType.description: Type of review if this layer is reviewed

humanGate.description: Whether human approval is required after this layer

onPass.description: Next layer ID on success, 'COMPLETE', or null

prompt.description: Full prompt template for the agent
